verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe several official SDKs. These include an SDK for automating account resources alongside the REST API, the AI SDK for calling models through AI Gateway, the Workflow SDK for durable agents, JS/Python Blob SDK references, and the Flags SDK, plus a published OpenAPI description. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the platform/REST SDK (languages, package names, coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
Automate projects, deployments, domains, and account resources through the Vercel REST API or SDK.
Call hundreds of models through one endpoint with the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL
Build durable, observable applications and AI agents with the Workflow SDK on a fully managed platform.
Run experiments on static pages with Statsig and the Flags SDK.
